name: two-stage-dcf
description: Two-stage enterprise valuation from staged financial statements and company text. Classifies every reported balance-sheet line and foots it, computes the historical driver ratios with a script, reads the MD&A, transcripts and press releases for evidence on each driver, and writes two HTML pages: the argument for each assumption, with quoted citations and a measured ranking of what moves the answer, and the valuation it produces. The numbers live in a CSV that rebuilds both pages, so the assumptions can be argued over and revised; when they are settled it delivers an Excel workbook whose model is live formulas, with sensitivity and driver-ranking sheets and a Check sheet that goes red if the formulas ever disagree with the Python engine.
